notes: kb/Work PB5925 (listing step 4b of docs/rearchitecture/DESIGN-listing.md, 2026-11-18), judged by the 2002 text. §2002:15.80.2 RV3: "The returned value shall denote the same time as the compilation date and time if provided in the listing and in the generated object code, although their representations and precision may differ." One instant per compilation (CompilationInputs.ReadCompilationTime captures the clock once): the listing heading prints it and the WHEN-COMPILED constant is baked from it. The witness compiles and runs a program at --std 2002 and finds the instant between two clock readings around the compilation, in the heading, and as the program's WHEN-COMPILED in RV1's 21 positions.
